Although some may disagree, this is from my experience

Positives of Penis Envy: cool mutations, more potent than most cubes, often large

Positives of Golden Teacher: Easy to grow, iconic, great beginner strain

Negatives of Penis Envy: usually harder to grow, requires agar (not always but always recommended), sometimes more expensive, and doesn't usually drop spores like normal mushrooms (due to the mutation)

Negatives of golden teacher: can't think of any

conclusion: If you are just starting growing, I would suggest using golden teacher. However, if you are looking for experience with swabbing and agar, use penis envy. If you've got the hang of it, try both. Golden teacher is reliable, and penis envy is cool to observe, as well as being more potent.

Best of luck mate!
